metadata.description: Personal engineering standards as Claude Code skills, grouped by domain. Install once, follow in every project.

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: Run a project end to end as one loop: spec with profile and risks, prototypes, plan, one task at a time, release, evolve; adopt existing codebases; loop.sh routes to only the domains a project needs.

plugins.name: agent-ops
plugins.description: Logs every agent action to .agent-log/, writes a goal contract before work, and blocks 'done' until each acceptance criterion has evidence.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: System design: repo and service shape, auth, data, APIs, ADRs. Writes docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md, the contract every other plugin reads.

plugins.name: ai-engineering
plugins.description: Design and run AI features: discovery, AI.md, feature cards, Laravel AI SDK / FastAPI + Pydantic AI, evals, safety, ops, and a learning loop into house defaults.

plugins.name: collaboration
plugins.description: Team git workflow: branch per plan task, Conventional Commits, PRs from PLAN + GOAL evidence, labelled reviews, repo setup; hook blocks force-push to main and bad commit messages.

plugins.name: code-standards
plugins.description: Write maintainable code: placed by ARCHITECTURE.md, consistent naming, errors at the right layer, tests with every change, safe refactors — Laravel, FastAPI, TS/React — plus command detection and a leftover check.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Security baseline (SECURITY.md), secure coding for Laravel/FastAPI/React, STRIDE threat models, secrets and dependency hygiene, full audits via Cloudflare's security-audit skill; hook blocks secrets in code.

plugins.name: testing
plugins.description: Pick tests from a change's conditions — mutation, property-based, contract, E2E, load, accessibility, visual — on top of code-standards unit/feature tests; diff-based planner and tool detection.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Delivery pipeline PR → production: CI templates (Laravel, FastAPI, Node), environments, IaC, observability and SLOs, safe release/rollback; hook asks before destructive infra or production commands.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Consistent shadcn + Tailwind dashboards: token-based UI system, component layers, dashboard patterns, consistency reviews, component/visual/a11y testing, performance budgets; hook flags values that bypass design tokens.

plugins.name: seo
plugins.description: Technical SEO: rendering/URLs/indexation (SEO.md), keyword research, Search Console + drop diagnosis, Core Web Vitals, live crawl audits, head tags, structured data, programmatic pages, hreflang; scripts for each.

plugins.name: backend
plugins.description: Build server code that survives production: thin handlers over services, zero-downtime migrations, background jobs that retry safely, outbound calls with timeouts and circuit breakers; Laravel + FastAPI; scanner and migration/job hook.
